_comment: Your whole schedule lives in this one file. Times are 24-hour. Playlist names must match your Sonos favourites EXACTLY, capitals included. Claude will fill this in with you.

stores.name: The bar
stores._ids_note: Leave these three as they are. The real values are GitHub secrets named SONOS_HOUSEHOLD_BAR, SONOS_GROUP_BAR and SONOS_SPEAKER_BAR, and the program reads them from there.
stores.speaker: KEPT_IN_GITHUB_SECURE_STORAGE
stores._leave_off_note: If someone turns the music off by hand, it stays off until the next slot starts, rather than restarting every fifteen minutes.

slots.name: Afternoon
slots._note: A pool of two or more is dealt one per day so the staff do not hear the same one daily. A single name works too.

stores._volume_note: The volume on each slot is a ceiling. Every fifteen minutes the program eases the speakers back to it if someone turned them up.

_seasons_holidays_note: Empty to start. Once the basics have run for a week, Claude can add a December block or a seasonal swap here.
